import os,signal,json
from pathlib import Path
pids=[]
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdigit():continue
 try:a=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
 except OSError:continue
 if b'app.main:app' in a and any(x==b'uvicorn' or x.endswith(b'/uvicorn') for x in a):pids.append(int(p.name))
assert len(pids)==1,pids
os.kill(pids[0],signal.SIGTERM)
print(json.dumps({'signal_sent':True,'uvicorn_process_count':len(pids)}))
